description:
C10 Model Call specification.

Frozen invocation parameters for reproducible local model execution.

call_id.description: Unique UUID for this inference call
call_id.title: Call Id

model_digest.description: Optional digest/hash of the local model weights
model_digest.title: Model Digest

prompt_version.description: Version identifier of the prompt template used
prompt_version.title: Prompt Version

system_prompt_version.description: Version identifier of system prompt if separated
system_prompt_version.title: System Prompt Version

context_limit.description: Maximum context window size for the model
context_limit.title: Context Limit

input_fingerprint.description: Content hash/fingerprint of the combined prompt input
input_fingerprint.title: Input Fingerprint

requested_schema.description: Name or ID of JSON schema for structured output generation
requested_schema.title: Requested Schema
